It never said they were moving south."},{"span":"The Kinn of the Long Grass remain settled in their three designated areas","reason":"This contradicts the earlier report that the Kinn are on the move. The voice is flat and bureaucratic, with almost none of Ilse's dry wit, and each paragraph has two sentences instead of the required three."}
